after_source: reference implementation in this PR; root remains legacy
merge_driver: native default; global and system Git configuration disabled in fixtures

red_before_green.before_observation: The real legacy register_file entry point updated the same files[] array on both branches. git merge-tree --write-tree returned 1 and named manifests/evidence.json as its only conflict.
red_before_green.after_observation: The explicitly opted-in writer creates separate deterministic record files. Native merge-tree returns 0; the seed and authored metadata are unchanged and both exact hash/byte records are present.

red_before_green.before_observation: The legacy Git-tree reader rejected the registered fragment artifact as a required registration row missing.
red_before_green.after_observation: The explicit record_fragments=True reference option accepts matching bytes, then rejects modified artifact bytes with SHA-256 mismatch at Git head. Default production callers remain on the legacy reader.

red_before_green.before_observation: The deliberate shared-array rewrite was accepted; the regression failed because InvalidPublication was not raised.
red_before_green.after_observation: The explicitly enabled historical validator rejects changes to the frozen files[] seed.

red_before_green.before_observation: The checker returned 0 after inspecting only the sorted seed, ignoring a bad fragment hash and boolean byte count; the regression failed.
red_before_green.after_observation: The checker returns 1 for malformed fragment metadata.

additional_boundaries: Competing changes to the same evidence record retain a native conflict.
publication_review, unknown record fields and unknown top-level metadata survive assembly.
No marker retains byte-exact legacy register_file output and creates no fragment directory.
Rendering does not read artifact bytes, refresh expected hashes or rewrite source records.
Historical assembly does not borrow records from the current checkout.
Misnamed and duplicate records, duplicate JSON keys, filesystem/Git-tree symlinks, path escapes and recursive registry registration fail.
Prior fragment history retains registration intent for non-evidence files after a later row deletion.
not_measured: Hosted merge-queue behavior of the proposed registry format.
Production reader/writer migration or root activation.
